svg.text: Comprehensive Side-by-Side Benchmark: Decompression & Compression Throughput and Ratios
Evaluated across 31 public datasets + 6 industrial scenarios (Metrics calculated using Geometric Mean)
Covering IoT telemetry, physical trends, quant finance, steady constants, geospatial, and public macro

g.text: NEON/NOAA air pressure, temperature, water level (1024 pts)
Monotonic ramp, USGS river discharge & river stage (1024 pts)
High-frequency trade prices: US, DE, UK stocks (1024 pts)
Fixed-range sensors, error-free health monitoring (1024 pts)
GPS latitude/longitude tracking, flight paths & migration (1024 pts)
Healthcare stats, macroeconomic indicators & commodity prices (1024 pts)

svg.text: Note: Overall decode/encode speeds and compression ratios are calculated using Geometric Mean across all 35 time-series datasets and scenarios. Measured directly on Apple M2 Max with C++ ALP official source. Exact IEEE 754 bitwise lossless.
